name: linnworks
description: Unofficial community plugin that connects Claude to your own Linnworks account: orders, stock, inventory, purchase orders, pickwaves and channel listings, through 104 tools. Write tools default to dry runs.

application_id.title: Linnworks Application ID
application_id.description: From your app in the Linnworks developer portal.

application_secret.title: Linnworks Application Secret
application_secret.description: From your app in the Linnworks developer portal.

installation_token.title: Linnworks installation token
installation_token.description: The permanent token shown when you install your app at apps.linnworks.net/Authorization/Authorize/<Application ID>.

default_shopify_store.title: Default Shopify store (optional)
default_shopify_store.description: The Linnworks SubSource name of the Shopify store the listing tools act on when you don't name one. Leave blank to be asked each time.

internal_skus.title: Internal marker SKUs (optional)
internal_skus.description: Comma-separated SKUs you add to orders on purpose (gift wrap, notes flags). find_unlinked_order_lines will not report them as orphaned.

pickwave_ready_tag.title: Pick-ready order tag (optional)
pickwave_ready_tag.description: An order identifier (tag) that marks an order as ready to pick. generate_pick_waves warns about any order without it. Leave blank for no check.

shopify_stores.title: Shopify Admin access (optional)
shopify_stores.description: Only for repair_channel_listing_images. JSON keyed by Linnworks SubSource, e.g. {"My Store":{"shop_domain":"x.myshopify.com","access_token":"shpat_..."}}.
